vulnerabilities.description: API credentials transmitted via Base64-encoded Authorization headers instead of secure token exchange
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Attacker intercepts browser traffic or accesses DevTools → decodes Base64 Authorization header with `atob()` → gains plaintext intervals.icu/Strava API keys → uploads malicious activities to athlete's connected services

vulnerabilities.description: API tokens stored in sessionStorage, accessible to any JavaScript including malicious XSS payload
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Malicious XSS in ride name or workout file → accesses window.sessionStorage['pf-bike-intervals-key'] → exfiltrates API token → uploads fake activities or deletes athlete records

vulnerabilities.description: Multiple innerHTML assignments with inconsistent escaping; dynamic content from workouts could bypass H.escHtml()
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Crafted ZWO workout file with XML entities like `<text><img src=x onerror='alert(1)'></text>` → parseXml() decodeEntities() → content passed to innerHTML → JavaScript executes in athlete's browser

vulnerabilities.description: Custom XML parser entity decoder lacks validation for numeric entity overflow and invalid Unicode code points
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Malformed ZWO file with numeric entity `&#0x110000;` (beyond Unicode range) or `󴈿` → parseInt without bounds check → invalid characters in parsed output → downstream processing fails or crashes

vulnerabilities.description: API upload tokens stored in sessionStorage during ride upload; no protection against token theft via F12 DevTools
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Athlete opens browser DevTools → navigates to Application → finds sessionStorage[pf-bike-strava-token] → reveals Strava OAuth token in plaintext → attacker can impersonate athlete's Strava account

vulnerabilities.description: Ride recording checkpoint stored in localStorage as plain JSON; no encryption or integrity check
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Athlete's localStorage contains in-progress ride with power/HR data and timestamps → another browser tab or XSS → modifies localStorage JSON (changes lap boundaries, inflates power output) → ride uploaded with tampered data → corrupts training analysis

vulnerabilities.description: Environment variable comments suggest Garmin password storage; plaintext password in memory during login
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Runner process crashes with core dump during Garmin login retry loop → password recoverable from process memory → attacker gains access to athlete's Garmin account

vulnerabilities.description: JSON.parse() used without schema validation; malformed workout files could introduce type confusion
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: ZWO file with steps array replaced by string `steps: 'invalid'` → JSON.parse succeeds → code calling steps.forEach() throws TypeError → unhandled exception could leak stack trace or hang the app

vulnerabilities.description: Missing Content-Security-Policy headers; no explicit protection against inline script injection
vulnerabilities.failure_scenario: Flask app doesn't set CSP header → attacker injects `<script>fetch(sessionStorage)</script>` via XSS → browser allows inline script execution (no CSP violation) → sensitive data exfiltrated

recommendations: Move API token storage to httpOnly cookies set by server; implement OAuth token exchange endpoint instead of storing tokens in browser
Add Content-Security-Policy header: `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'` to prevent inline scripts
Validate all XML/JSON inputs against strict schemas; add bounds checking to numeric entity decoder (Unicode 0x0-0x10FFFF only)
Replace all innerHTML assignments with textContent or createElement; audit H.escHtml() for edge cases in attribute/URL contexts
Encrypt localStorage and sessionStorage data using TweetNaCl.js or libsodium.js if local storage is required
Clear Garmin password from memory immediately after first login attempt; don't keep in retry loop; use device OAuth flow instead
Set security headers on all responses: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block
Implement input validation tests for malformed ZWO/ERG/MRC files; fuzzing with AFL or libFuzzer
Add HMAC integrity check to localStorage checkpoints to detect tampering
Reduce SESSION_TTL from 180 days to 7-14 days; implement refresh token pattern
